<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="PUDWo5MwEpMoxeTGAYDw"> <mxGraphModel dx="3096" dy="1804" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml Database_Diagram
skinparam entity {
 BackgroundColor white
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 FontName Arial
 FontSize 9
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F8F9FA
 BorderColor #ADB5BD
 FontStyle bold
 FontSize 10
}
skinparam note {
 BackgroundColor #FFF9C4
 BorderColor #F9A825
 FontSize 8
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' IDENTITY & ACCESS
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Identity & Access\" #EBF5FB {

 entity \"tenants\" as tenants {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, ten-uuid>>
 ==
 * name : VARCHAR
 * contact_email : VARCHAR
 * is_active : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 entity \"users\" as users {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, user-uuid>>
 ==
 tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 ==
 * email : VARCHAR <<UNIQUE>>
 * password_hash : VARCHAR
 * full_name : VARCHAR
 * role : ENUM
 phone : VARCHAR
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of users
 role: superadmin | admin |
 operator | dispatcher | passenger
 tenant_id is NULL for superadmin
 end note
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' FLEET OPERATIONS
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Fleet Operations\" #E9F7EF {

 entity \"vehicles\" as vehicles {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, veh-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * registration_number : VARCHAR
 * model : VARCHAR
 * capacity : INTEGER
 * status : ENUM
 lat : FLOAT
 lng : FLOAT
 speed : INTEGER
 heading : INTEGER
 fuel : INTEGER
 * engine_status : ENUM
 route_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 driver_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of vehicles
 status: active | idle |
 maintenance | offline
 engine_status: good | warning | critical
 fuel: percentage 0–100
 end note

 entity \"drivers\" as drivers {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, drv-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * name : VARCHAR
 * license_number : VARCHAR
 * phone : VARCHAR
 * rating : FLOAT
 * total_trips : INTEGER
 * status : ENUM
 vehicle_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 * certification_expiry : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of drivers
 status: available | on-trip | off-duty
 end note
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' ROUTE NETWORK
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Route Network\" #FEF9E7 {

 entity \"routes\" as routes {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, route-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * name : VARCHAR
 * number : VARCHAR
 * distance : FLOAT
 * duration : INTEGER
 * is_active : BOOLEAN
 * color : VARCHAR
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 entity \"route_stops\" as route_stops {
 * route_id : VARCHAR <<PK, FK>>
 * stop_id : VARCHAR <<PK, FK>>
 ==
 * stop_order : INTEGER
 }

 entity \"stops\" as stops {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, stop-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * name : VARCHAR
 * lat : FLOAT
 * lng : FLOAT
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' SCHEDULING
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Scheduling\" #F5EEF8 {

 entity \"trips\" as trips {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, trip-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 * vehicle_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 * route_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 * driver_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * scheduled_start : TIMESTAMPTZ
 actual_start : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * scheduled_end : TIMESTAMPTZ
 actual_end : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * status : ENUM
 * passengers : INTEGER
 * delay : INTEGER
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of trips
 status: scheduled | active |
 completed | cancelled
 actual_start / actual_end set
 on status transition
 end note
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' MONITORING
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Monitoring\" #FDEDEC {

 entity \"telemetry\" as telemetry {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, telem-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 * vehicle_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * lat : FLOAT
 * lng : FLOAT
 * speed : INTEGER
 * heading : INTEGER
 * timestamp : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note bottom of telemetry
 Append-only. No is_deleted or updated_at.
 One row per active vehicle per 5-second cycle.
 end note

 entity \"alerts\" as alerts {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, alert-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 vehicle_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 driver_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 ==
 * type : ENUM
 * severity : ENUM
 * title : VARCHAR
 * message : TEXT
 * is_acknowledged : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of alerts
 type: delay | breakdown | maintenance |
 speeding | geofence | info
 severity: low | medium | high | critical
 No is_deleted or updated_at.
 end note

 entity \"maintenance_records\" as maintenance {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, maint-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 * vehicle_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * type : ENUM
 * description : VARCHAR
 * scheduled_date : DATE
 completed_date : DATE
 * cost : FLOAT
 * status : ENUM
 next_due : DATE
 * is_deleted : BOOLEAN
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 * updated_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of maintenance
 type: routine | repair | inspection
 status: scheduled | in-progress | completed
 end note
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' ANALYTICS & AUDIT
' ══════════════════════════════════════
package \"Analytics & Audit\" #F0F3F4 {

 entity \"analytics\" as analytics {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, analytics-uuid>>
 ==
 * tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * date : DATE
 * total_fuel_consumption : FLOAT
 * total_revenue : FLOAT
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note bottom of analytics
 One row per tenant per day (UNIQUE).
 Trip counts, on-time % and delay
 metrics computed dynamically
 from the trips table at query time.
 end note

 entity \"audit_logs\" as audit_logs {
 * id : VARCHAR <<PK, audit-uuid>>
 ==
 tenant_id : VARCHAR <<FK, nullable>>
 * user_id : VARCHAR <<FK>>
 ==
 * entity_type : VARCHAR
 * entity_id : VARCHAR
 * action_type : ENUM
 metadata : JSONB
 * created_at : TIMESTAMPTZ
 }

 note right of audit_logs
 action_type: create | update |
 soft_delete | login | impersonate
 Immutable. No is_deleted or updated_at.
 tenant_id is NULL for superadmin actions.
 end note
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════
' RELATIONSHIPS
' ══════════════════════════════════════

' Tenancy
tenants ||--o{ users : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ vehicles : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ drivers : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ routes : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ trips : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ alerts : \" \"
tenants ||--o{ analytics : \" \"

' Route network
routes ||--|{ route_stops : \" \"
stops ||--o{ route_stops : \" \"

' Scheduling
routes ||--o{ trips : \" \"
vehicles ||--o{ trips : \" \"
drivers ||--o{ trips : \" \"

' Vehicle monitoring
vehicles ||--o{ telemetry : \" \"
vehicles ||--o{ maintenance : \" \"
vehicles |o--o{ alerts : \" \"
drivers |o--o{ alerts : \" \"

' Audit
users ||--o{ audit_logs : \" \"

@enduml
